perf.summary: Edge-add helpers take an unused `int* edgeCount` parameter, and AddEdge/AddDirectedEdge are byte-identical; AggressiveInlining is missing on these tiny hot leaves.
perf.currentCost: The unused `edgeCount` parameter forces callers (BuildAdjacency passes `&m`) to materialize an address and occupies an argument register on every call. Without inlining, BuildAdjacency pays a call per edge.
perf.proposedChange: Drop the unused edgeCount parameter, collapse AddDirectedEdge into AddEdge (identical bodies), and mark Run with [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)] so BuildAdjacency's per-edge call is inlined into a few pointer writes.
perf.rationale: Removes a dead parameter and a redundant address-of in the build loop, and inlining a 4-statement leaf eliminates call overhead across all m edges.
perf.risk: Signature change is an API break for callers; mechanical. Inlining a tiny pointer-only leaf is safe and Burst-friendly. Outputs identical.
